question: What ability arises for one whose mind is absorbed in single-pointed meditation?
premises: The mind becomes one-pointed in meditation.
The practitioner can assume many forms.
inference: One whose mind is absorbed in single-pointed meditation can create many forms.
uncertainties: compound dhyāna eka gata cetasaḥ analyzed across tokens as given
plain_english: One whose mind is absorbed in single-pointed meditation can assume many forms.
